must-read.title: Sanctions Target Iran’s Weakened Regional Network
must-read.summary: The US is preparing a new campaign of economic pressure on Iran after diplomacy and months of fighting failed to produce a durable settlement, with President Donald Trump warning countries against maintaining trade ties with Tehran. Atlantic writer and Columbia University Institute of Global Politics Distinguished Fellow Kim Ghattas is on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that sanctions remain a blunt tool that will deepen hardship for ordinary Iranians, but Tehran’s weakened regional network and growing economic strain could make the latest pressure campaign different from those of the past 47 years. (Source: Bloomberg)

must-read.title: Study Shows AI Hitting Paychecks, Not Payrolls
must-read.summary: Apollo Chief Economist Torsten Slok says early labor-market data suggest AI’s first impact is appearing more in wages than employment. In a study of hundreds of occupations, Slok found that jobs with higher exposure to AI have seen weaker wage growth, while the employment effect remains relatively small. But the picture is still coming into focus: Slok says AI is also helping fuel record business formation, which could create new jobs and make the economy more dynamic. Former IBM HR chief Diane Gherson says companies are already deciding which work can be automated, which employees can be retrained and whether AI savings come through layoffs, slower hiring or reskilling. (Source: Bloomberg)
must-read.title_cn: 研究表明，人工智能正影响工资收入，而非工资支出。
must-read.summary_cn: Apollo首席经济学家Torsten Slok表示，早期劳动力市场数据显示，人工智能的首次影响更多地体现在工资上，而非就业。在对数百个职业的研究中，Slok发现，人工智能暴露度更高的工作岗位工资增长更为疲软，而就业效应仍相对较小。但情况仍在逐渐明朗：Slok表示，人工智能也在推动创纪录的商业创业活动，这可能创造新就业机会并使经济更具活力。前IBM人力资源主管Diane Gherson表示，企业已经在决定哪些工作可以被自动化、哪些员工可以再培训，以及人工智能的节约是通过裁员、放慢招聘还是再培训来实现。（来源：彭博社）
must-read.ai_summary: Apollo 首席经济学家托斯滕·斯洛克表示，早期劳动力市场数据显示，AI 的首个影响更多地体现在工资上，而非就业。在对数百个职业的研究中，斯洛克发现，受 AI 影响更大的岗位工资增长更弱，而就业效应仍然相对较小。但情况仍在逐步明朗：斯洛克指出，AI 同时也在推动创纪录的企业创立，这可能创造新的就业机会，使经济更具活力。前 IBM 人力资源主管黛安·格尔森表示，企业已经在决定哪些工作可以自动化、哪些员工可以再培训，以及 AI 的节约是通过裁员、放慢招聘还是再培训来实现。（来源：Bloomberg）

投资参考.title: US Colleges Face a Shrinking Student Pipeline
投资参考.summary: US colleges are confronting a prolonged demographic squeeze as the number of high school graduates, after peaking in 2025, is projected to decline 13% through 2041, putting particular pressure on regional schools with limited endowments. Joining David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend is Carleton College Professor of Economics Nathan Grawe who explains that institutions are cutting programs, competing harder for students and emphasizing affordability and return on investment, while inflation-adjusted tuition at public four-year colleges has fallen 7% over the past decade. (Source: Bloomberg)
投资参考.title_cn: 美国大学面临学生来源萎缩
投资参考.summary_cn: 美国大学正面临长期的人口压力，因为高中生毕业人数在2025年达到峰值后，预计到2041年将下降13%，这给资源有限、捐赠基金不足的地区院校带来特别大的压力。本周末在彭博社节目《Bloomberg This Weekend》上，David Gura 与 Christina Ruffini 邀请了卡尔顿学院经济学教授 Nathan Grawe，他解释道，高校正在削减课程项目，更加激烈地争夺学生，并强调可负担性和投资回报率，而在过去十年中，公立四年制大学的通胀调整后学费已下降7%。（来源：彭博社）
投资参考.ai_summary: 美国的大学正面临长期的人口压力，因为高中生毕业人数在2025年达到峰值后，预计到2041年将下降13%，给捐赠基金有限的地方院校带来特别压力。本期彭博周末节目中，卡尔顿学院经济学教授内森·格劳（Nathan Grawe）与大卫·古拉（David Gura）和克里斯蒂娜·拉菲尼（Christina Ruffini）共同参与，他解释道，高校正在削减项目，更加激烈地争夺学生，并强调负担能力和投资回报，而过去十年中公立四年制大学经通胀调整的学费下降了7%。(来源：彭博)
